Subject: Discovery recap - Data privacy & logging (FinServ Solutions)

Hi Elena - thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're aligned on pain, goals, and next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared:
- PII and sensitive financial data flowing into ML endpoints; strict redaction and masking requirements.
- Need immutable audit logs for every inference (who/when/input hash/model/version/tokens).
- Per-customer retention policies (some business lines require 7 years; others require 2).
- Data residency: production data must remain in customer-managed AWS where possible.
- Security review expects exportable evidence (SOC 2 artifacts, KMS integration, and access logs).

Current stack you described:
- In-house microservices calling LLM endpoints via proxy (AWS VPC + Splunk for logs).
- Authentication via OIDC, centralized SIEM ingest to Splunk.
- Dev team prefers a private deployment model for initial PoC (staging in your AWS account).

Success criteria for a 6-week PoC:
1) Private deployment in your staging account or VPC that routes inference traffic from one service.
2) Demonstrable redaction pipeline for PII at ingestion with configurable rules + sample audit logs exported to S3.
3) SOC2 snapshot and architecture diagram submitted to your InfoSec team; ability to run a short security review.
4) Performance target: 95th-percentile latency within your SLA envelope for interactive flows.

What I've attached for your review:
- SOC2-snapshot-2026Q3.pdf (high-level artifacts we typically share)
- redaction-specs.xlsx (how we handle configurable redaction & token masking)
- mutual-action-plan-FinServ.docx (initial timeline and ownerships)

Proposed next steps:
- I'll loop in Vivek (infrastructure) and Dev (technical lead) to schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week to confirm logging formats and S3 export mechanics.
- We'll scope the PoC and provide an estimated cost for a Dedicated/private footprint for the initial 6-week run.

If that all looks right I'll follow up with proposed times for the technical call. Thanks again - and happy to answer anything else upfront.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

--

From: Elena Su <elena.su@finserv.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap - Data privacy & logging (FinServ Solutions)

Hi Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifying points and asks from InfoSec before we lock the PoC timeline:

1) Retention: some lines of business require exactly 7 years retention for audit data; others are 2 years. Can Redwood support per-customer and per-tenant retention TTLs (and automatic purging)?
2) Redaction: do you support both pre-ingest deterministic redaction (regex + rule engine) and post-generation PII redaction? We need the ability to define rules per dataset.
3) Audit logs: sample format request - our compliance team needs to see a log schema (fields, retention, immutability guarantees). Ideally logs land in our S3 bucket (in our AWS account) and are write-once.
4) Residency: For the PoC we'd prefer the private deployment inside our AWS account. Is that supported? If not, can you provide a clear network diagram and controls for cross-account access?

Attached is a short doc with our redaction requirements (FinServ-Reqs-Redaction.docx) - please comment on anything you can't meet.

Target: we want to decide on the PoC kickoff by Nov 20th; the PoC itself would be ~6 weeks. Can you confirm rough cost ballpark for a Dedicated/private PoC?

Thanks —
Elena Su
Director, Platform Security
FinServ Solutions

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap - Data privacy & logging (FinServ Solutions)

Elena - quick answers to the specific questions you raised and what we can provide for the PoC: (looping Marissa + Dev)

- Per-customer/tenant retention: yes - the platform supports configurable retention TTLs per-customer and per-environment. We can enforce auto-purge policies and provide a documented deletion audit trail.

- Redaction capabilities: we support both pre-ingest deterministic redaction (regex/structured parsers) and configurable post-processing redaction. For PoC we'll work with your team to onboard your rule set (we can import rules from a CSV or the attached spreadsheet format). We also support token-level masking at the model layer for sensitive fields.

- Audit logs & export: sample schema we typically provide includes: request_id, timestamp (ISO8601), account_id, tenant_id, source_ip, service_principal, model_name, model_version, input_hash, redacted_fields (list), outcome (redacted/allowed), token_count, latency_ms, storage_location (S3 path or internal blob reference). Logs can be exported to your S3 bucket (cross-account write) or streamed to your SIEM (Splunk/Datadog) via our delivery connectors. We support writing logs encrypted with your KMS.

- Residency & deployment: we support private deployments in customer-managed AWS accounts (our Private mode). For PoC we can push a minimal footprint into your staging account; we'll need one AWS admin from your side to approve cross-account roles and S3 write policies.

Attachments: redaction-specs.xlsx (provides rule CSV + example regexes + mapping to log fields).

Next logistics:
- I can host the technical deep-dive on Nov 17 or Nov 18 (preferred window: 10:00 - 13:00 PT). Marissa, can you confirm which day works for FinServ?
- Budget: for a 6-week Dedicated/private PoC with minimal reserved capacity and data export to your S3, rough ballpark is $18k - $28k depending on throughput and retention configuration. We'll provide a more detailed estimate after the tech scoping call.

Let us know and we'll send a calendar invite and the updated MAP (I'll include the HubSpot deal id: RWI-FTS-2026-045).

Thanks,
